description: We are enthusiastic computer science students passionate about space exploration, technology, and innovation. Our interests include web development, AI/ML, software engineering, and data analysis. We aim to build creative, practical solutions using NASA's open datasets. We welcome passionate teammates interested in coding, research, design, and problem-solving. Let's collaborate, learn, and create something impactful!
summary:
📝 Summary-
Forgotten Space Explorers is an interactive storytelling experience created for NASA’s 2026 Space Apps Challenge, “Abandoned but not Forgotten.” It introduces school-age space enthusiasts to ten spacecraft, landers, and rovers left behind across the Solar System, and the discoveries their missions made possible. Visitors can explore an interactive Solar System, browse mission cards, step through timelines, and view simplified 3D models. Each story pairs clearly labeled, imagined first-person narration with a fact-checked mission record and links to NASA and mission-partner sources. AI-generated illustrations are identified as such, while archival images are credited. By making the history of these machines accessible and engaging, the project helps young audiences see that a mission’s scientific legacy can continue long after the spacecraft’s journey ends.
details:
🌌 Details

Forgotten Space Explorers is an interactive story experience created in response to the 2026 NASA Space Apps Challenge, “Abandoned but not Forgotten: Storytelling about NASA’s Discarded Equipment on the Moon and Mars.” Designed for school-age space enthusiasts, it explores NASA spacecraft, landers, and rovers across the Solar System through source-linked mission facts, timelines, and imaginative first-person stories.

💻 Tech Stack

  • React 19, TypeScript, and Vite
  • Tailwind CSS 4 and React Router
  • Three.js, React Three Fiber, and Drei
  • Framer Motion

✨ Innovation Highlights

  • 📖 Narrative Design: Ten mission stories combine imaginative narration with documented facts.
  • 🪐 Interactive Exploration: A Solar System orrery connects destinations with related equipment and stories.
  • 🔭 Educational Value: Introduces the missions and science behind equipment across the Moon, Venus, Mars, deep space, and asteroids.
  • 🎨 Visual Experience: Interactive 3D models and visibly labeled AI-generated illustrations; NASA archival photographs are credited separately.
  • 📡 Data Trust: Mission information links to NASA Science, NASA’s NSSDC Master Catalog, NASA History, and Johns Hopkins APL.

👥 Team Cosmic Night: Tresha Sree and Siri Chandana
